fact_previews: 3-2-1 Race-it! is an arcade-inspired racing game.
The core feature of 3-2-1 Race-it! is that players can race on a track to beat their high score and be included on the leaderboard.
Players have a selection of racetracks and challenges to test their skills.
The funding goal for 3-2-1 Race-it! was $21,184.
$830 was pledged towards the funding goal.

fact_previews: Users can create their own racing track in the game and share it to compete for a place on the leaderboard.
Players can customize their car's specifications, including speed, turning ability, and airtime before crashing.
Customization options for cars include decals, colors, and tires, with no microtransactions involved.
The game features a challenge mode where players can test their skills to achieve the fastest time and discover new ways to complete challenges.
Race modifiers can be added to enhance variety, impacting the state of the map and visibility.
